assumptions.methodology: Data extracted from SEC filings (10-K, 10-Q), investor presentations, quarterly earnings reports, SBA lender data, and industry sources

key_assumptions.assumption: Estimated at 21% of total deposits based on customer distribution (3.3M business / 70M+ total customers)
key_assumptions.confidence: Medium - Wells Fargo does not break out small business deposits separately

key_assumptions.assumption: Estimated at 24% of commercial loan portfolio ($145B of $600B) based on customer segment size
key_assumptions.confidence: Medium - Derived from total commercial loans and customer distribution

key_assumptions.assumption: Estimated at 32% of Consumer & Small Business segment revenue ($12B of $37B)
key_assumptions.confidence: Medium - Wells Fargo reports combined consumer and small business

key_assumptions.assumption: Set at 62% (lower than Chase 65%) reflecting tighter lending standards and regulatory constraints
key_assumptions.confidence: High - Supported by FDIC data showing large banks at 68% approval in 2024

key_assumptions.assumption: Set at 14.5% (higher than Chase 12%) due to elevated CRE exposure and charge-off trends
key_assumptions.confidence: High - Calculated from actual charge-off rates (0.24-0.35%) and NPA levels

key_assumptions.assumption: Set at 32% (lower than Chase 35%) reflecting West Coast market dynamics and reduced digital capabilities
key_assumptions.confidence: Medium - Industry average for large banks is 30-40%

key_assumptions.assumption: $85K (lower than Chase $95K) reflecting conservative underwriting post-scandal
key_assumptions.confidence: Medium - Based on average loan sizes and risk appetite

key_assumptions.assumption: 8.5% small business loans, 9.2% business deposits based on relative size to Chase and regional concentration
key_assumptions.confidence: Medium - No official market share data available; derived from customer counts and portfolio sizes

key_assumptions.assumption: $8.5B estimated portfolio after product sunset and relaunch
key_assumptions.confidence: Low - Wells Fargo does not disclose business card portfolio size; major reduction from historical levels

data_quality_notes: Wells Fargo reports Consumer, Small & Business Banking as a combined segment - business banking metrics are derived
SBA lending data is official from SBA fiscal year 2024 reports
Charge-off rates and deposit/loan totals are directly from Wells Fargo financial statements
Geographic market share estimates based on branch presence and regional deposit data
Asset cap constraint (Fed order) limits balance sheet growth and impacts growth metrics
